title: [main] Wrong Financial entries in Import Duty GST Calculation
summary: Fixed incorrect GST and import duty financial entries when invoicing partially received purchase orders for Import and SEZ vendors by ensuring Qty. to invoice reflects only received-but-not-invoiced quantities.
key_points: Corrects GST/import duty financial entries for partial receipts on import and SEZ purchase orders
Qty. to invoice now calculated correctly after receipt posting and undo receipt operations
Prevents inclusion of not-yet-received quantities in invoice calculations
Applies to GST Vendor Ledger Entry processing for Indian GST compliance
quote: Incorrect GST/import duty financial entries can occur when invoicing partially received purchase orders for Import and SEZ vendors.
